title: ContextUse
description: `GET /sessions/:sessionId/context`: how full the context window of a live session is, by category, against the window of its model (plan 08, B-37; plan 28, B-24). `409 ENGINE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE` when the engine has no `contextUse`.

model.description: The model whose window this is.

categories.description: What the window holds, by category.

id.description: `system`, `tools`, `messages`, `memory`, `free` or `reserved` — the canonical categories, each with a `messageKey` — or an id of the engine's own, opaque, for what only it counts apart.

messageKey.description: The key that names a canonical category, `sessions.context.<id>`. Absent otherwise: the client shows `text`.

text.description: The engine's own name for a category with no key — its words, shown as they are. Absent on a canonical one.

kind.description: What the category is: in use, free, kept aside, or deferred until needed.
